title: White Sands Retreat Vacation Rental
meta_description: White Sands Retreat is a 5.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhite Sands RetreatGulf Place Area of 30A – Cypress Breeze Plantation31 Breezeway Blvd, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights:5 Bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab for configurations)3.5 Bathrooms4,073 sq. ft.Downstairs porch overlooks spacious, grassy backyard and community poolFirst Floor: King Master Suite with private bathroom, half bath, airy kitchen, and cozy living & dining areaSecond Floor: King Guest Suite with Jack-and-Jill bath access, Queen Guest Suite with hall bath access, bunk room with two twin-over-full bunk beds, additional den, and large covered balconyFour-vehicle driveway + 1 garage spaceAll-new furnishings throughoutOutdoor gas grillFour 26” adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; additional rentals available)Golf carts available for rent through vendorInternet-based TVs (no cable)Escape the hustle and bustle and relax in this beautiful, newly purchased five-bedroom home in the gated Cypress Breeze Plantation. The first floor features a spacious, open kitchen and living area, a king master suite, and a large covered porch with backyard perfect for family fun. Upstairs, enjoy a second king bedroom, queen bedroom, bunk room, extra den, and a covered balcony with stunning sunset views along 30A.Location:Just a short bike ride, golf cart trip, or walk to Gulf Place’s dining and shopping, including Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, Perfect Pig, Pizza by the Sea, ice cream shops, and more.Community Amenities:Private community pool with waterfall and lounging areasGuest use begins at noon; pool open for homeowners only 8 a.m.–noonMain pool gate entry required; guests under 18 must be accompanied by an adultPool cannot be heatedBeach Access:1 mile to Ed Walline Regional Beach Access (approx. 2–3 min drive or 4–5 min bike ride)Public access with parking, restrooms, and outdoor showersOptional professional beach chair setups availableParking:Four-vehicle driveway + one garage spaceStreet or yard parking prohibited by HOA; overflow parking available at the pool with prior approvalBooking & Policies:No smokingNo pets (except certified service animals with documentation)Rates do not include tax and fees50% of total due at booking; balance due 30 days prior to arrival (or in full if booking within 30 days)Cancellations more than 30 days before arrival: initial 50% refundable (minus 5% processing fee)Optional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 P.M. (CST) | Check-out: 10:00 A.M.Renters must be 25+Relax, unwind, and enjoy the white sands of Florida at White Sands Retreat—the perfect spot for family vacations or a peaceful getaway along 30A.

2nd Floor King Guest Suite: King - Access to Hall Bathroom with Walk-In Shower
